name: fig22_density_matrix_gallery
caption: Magnitudes |rho_ij| of two-qubit density matrices in the computational basis, with global entropy S, single-qubit entropy S(A) and purity Tr(rho^2) in the panel titles. The Bell state has off-diagonal coherences between |00> and |11>; the separable mixture has coherences too but is not entangled (negativity 0).
